            if src[offset] != 0xFF:
                offset += 1
                continue

            # Skip any padding bytes, the marker code follows the final 0xFF
            while src[offset] == 0xFF:
                offset += 1

            code = src[offset]
            marker = src[offset - 1 : offset + 1]
            offset += 1

            # Standalone markers without a length: TEM, SOI, EOI and RSTn
            if code == 0x01 or code == 0xD8 or code == 0xD9 or 0xD0 <= code <= 0xD7:
                continue

            # The segment length includes the 2 bytes used to encode it
            length = int.from_bytes(src[offset : offset + 2], "big")
            if length < 2:
                return {}

            data = src[offset + 2 : offset + length]

            if code in sof_markers or code == 0xF7:
                # SOFn (JPEG) or SOF55 (JPEG-LS)
                info["precision"] = data[0]
                info["height"] = int.from_bytes(data[1:3], "big")
                info["width"] = int.from_bytes(data[3:5], "big")
                info["components"] = data[5]
                info["component_ids"] = [data[6 + ii * 3] for ii in range(data[5])]
                is_jls = code == 0xF7
            elif 0xE0 <= code <= 0xEF:
                # APPn segment
                app_markers[marker] = data
            elif code == 0xDA:
                # SOS - the start of the entropy coded data
                if is_jls:
                    # JPEG-LS: Ns, per-component (Cs, Tm) then NEAR, ILV and Pt
                    nr_components = data[0]
                    info["lossy_error"] = data[1 + nr_components * 2]
                    info["interleave_mode"] = data[2 + nr_components * 2]

                break

            offset += length
    except IndexError:
        return {}

    if app_markers:
        info["app"] = app_markers

    return info

entries.content: Done. The root cause was that `_get_jpg_parameters` in `src/pydicom/pixels/utils.py` was a stub that returned an empty dict unconditionally. I implemented a proper JPEG/JPEG-LS marker parser: it validates the SOI marker, walks the marker segments (skipping padding and standalone markers), extracts `precision`/`height`/`width`/`components`/`component_ids` from SOFn (JPEG) and SOF55 (JPEG-LS) segments, collects APPn segment payloads into an `app` dict keyed by marker bytes, and for JPEG-LS streams pulls `lossy_error` (NEAR) and `interleave_mode` (ILV) from the SOS segment header before stopping at the entropy-coded data. Truncated or malformed codestreams return `{}` (guarded by IndexError handling and a length sanity check that also prevents infinite loops). All `TestGetJpgParameters` tests pass except three that require downloading data files unavailable in the offline environment (they fail identically on the unpatched baseline), and no regressions were introduced in `tests/pixels/test_utils.py` or `tests/pixels/test_decoder_base.py`.
